desc: Read input N, M and the list of colored cells.
Use dictionaries to store `min_R` and `min_C`, initialized implicitly to 0.
Iterate through all black cells to populate `min_R` and `min_C` with the maximum required thresholds.
Iterate through all white cells to verify the consistency condition: `min_R[X] < Y` or `min_C[Y] < X`.
If any white cell fails the check, print "No". If all pass, print "Yes".
